import.note: putPage/upsertChunks latency percentiles exclude the first 25 samples (warm-up); throughput counts every page

memory.client_peak_rss_method: /proc/self/status VmHWM of the benchmark process (includes the WASM heap for PGLite). Baseline is VmRSS after the dataset is built and before the engine opens; engine RSS is peak minus baseline.
memory.server_peak_working_set_method: container cgroup memory.current minus inactive_file (the docker stats definition), sampled every 100 ms

cold_start.method: each rep: stop the server container (not timed), start it (timed), then a fresh client process connects, runs initSchema and answers one keyword query. total_ms is client-side; median_server_to_answer_ms covers server start too. OS file cache is warm.

disk.method: du -sb of PGDATA inside the container after CHECKPOINT

inputs.memory_basis: engine-attributable client RSS (peak minus harness baseline) + peak server working set

pglite_vs_postgres.direction: differences are other minus reference; ratios are other over reference
pglite_vs_postgres.method: per query (latency, quality) or per block of identical operations (cost): same input on both engines, back to back, in a seeded random order. Clustered paired bootstrap, 95% percentile interval, 10000 draws, seed 1337; sign-flip p-values, Holm-adjusted across the 9 latency operations. Each query (or block) is its own cluster.

reasons: PGLite hybrid p95 16.3 ms, interactive limit 100 ms
